description.value: Hillside Lodge & Chalets is a family-run property along the Blaeberry River outside Golden, BC, comprising multiple self-contained one- and two-bedroom cabins each with a kitchenette, wood stove, and private porch. Originally founded as a bed and breakfast in the 1990s, it now operates primarily as a wedding venue on summer weekends and a winter ski getaway near Kicking Horse Mountain Resort. Cabins are explicitly positioned as a place to unplug, with limited WiFi and no TV.

address.value: 1740 Seward Frontage Road, Golden, B.C., V0A1H1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms core contact details (phone, address, website) matching OSM. The site describes a family-run wedding venue and self-contained cabin rental property in Golden, BC; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, laundry) are mentioned anywhere in the content. The website explicitly states limited WiFi is available in the cabins.
concerns: OSM name 'Hillside Lodge and Chalet' does not match website branding 'Hillside Lodge & Chalets' (plural).
Summer availability is highly restricted: website states 'we are fully booked each weekend' during summer wedding season, which is peak cycling season.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate accommodation in a prime cycling destination (Golden, BC / Kicking Horse area), but no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned and summer availability is severely limited as the property is fully booked by weddings each summer weekend. Requires direct outreach to confirm bike storage and off-wedding-weekend availability for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property offers short- and longer-term winter cabin rentals explicitly; summer bookings are primarily wedding-party driven. A touring cyclist visiting outside wedding weekends could likely book, but this is not a cyclist-oriented property.

Wi-Fi.detail: Explicitly described as limited: 'Our cabins don't include TV & only limited WIFI - you're welcome!'
